title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to set the minimum and maximum numeric values ​​for a field
summary: Setting minimum and maximum numeric values for fields in Business Central can be done using MinValue/MaxValue properties or OnValidate triggers. The property-based approach validates only through the UI, while OnValidate triggers provide more control and validate application code changes.
key_points: MinValue and MaxValue properties restrict field values at the table and page control levels with built-in validation messages.
Properties validate only UI changes; direct table updates via code bypass validation.
OnValidate triggers on table fields run before page field triggers and allow custom range logic.
Properties cannot enforce exclusive bounds; OnValidate triggers enable stricter constraints like greater-than-zero-only rules.
